title: CloudDash Pricing Plans and Feature Comparison
content:
# CloudDash Pricing Plans and Feature Comparison

## Plan Overview

### Starter Plan — $49/month
- Up to 10 monitored hosts
- 5 users
- 50 alert rules
- 7-day data retention
- Email notifications only
- AWS integration only
- Community support
- Basic dashboards (up to 10)

### Pro Plan — $199/month
- Up to 100 monitored hosts
- 25 users
- 500 alert rules
- 30-day data retention
- Email, Slack, PagerDuty, webhook notifications
- AWS, GCP, Azure integrations
- Priority email support (24hr response)
- Custom dashboards (unlimited)
- Anomaly detection
- API access (10,000 requests/day)

### Enterprise Plan — $599/month (or custom)
- Unlimited monitored hosts
- Unlimited users
- Unlimited alert rules
- 365-day data retention
- All notification channels + SMS
- All cloud integrations + custom
- Dedicated support engineer (4hr response SLA)
- SSO/SAML support
- RBAC and audit logs
- API access (100,000 requests/day)
- Dashboard caching
- Custom metrics
- SLA guarantee (99.9% uptime)
- Data export and compliance reports

## Feature Comparison Table

| Feature | Starter | Pro | Enterprise |
|---------|---------|-----|------------|
| Monitored Hosts | 10 | 100 | Unlimited |
| Users | 5 | 25 | Unlimited |
| Data Retention | 7 days | 30 days | 365 days |
| Cloud Providers | AWS | AWS, GCP, Azure | All + Custom |
| SSO/SAML | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ |
| Anomaly Detection | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |
| API Access | ✗ | 10K/day | 100K/day |
| RBAC | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ |
| SLA Guarantee | ✗ | ✗ | 99.9% |

## Billing Cycle

- All plans are billed monthly.
- Annual billing available at 20% discount.
- All prices are in USD.
